Prior sensitivity

Source: R/kb_sensitivity.R
kb_sensitivity.Rd

Assess how much each parameter's posterior depends on its prior and on the data, by power-scaling (Kallioinen et al. 2024).

Usage

kb_sensitivity(fit, ..., prior_threshold = 0.1, likelihood_threshold = 0.05)

Arguments

fit

A kb_fit object.

...

These dots are for future extensions and must be empty.

prior_threshold

A number greater than 0: a parameter with prior_cjs below it has a weak prior.

likelihood_threshold

A number greater than 0: a parameter with likelihood_cjs at or above it has strong data.

Value

A tibble with one row per parameter that has a prior and columns term (the parameter, which is also its prior entry), prior_cjs and likelihood_cjs (the sensitivity to the prior and to the likelihood), weak_prior, strong_data, and informative_prior (whether the prior is informative by design).

Details

A parameter is driven by the data when it has both weak_prior and strong_data; see the Advanced article for the other cases. The cover calibration's tide_height_slope has an informative prior by design, so informative_prior marks it. Requires the priorsense package.

References

Kallioinen, N., Paananen, T., Bürkner, P.-C., and Vehtari, A. (2024). Detecting and diagnosing prior and likelihood sensitivity with power-scaling. Statistics and Computing, 34, 57.

See also

Other diagnostics: kb_converged(), kb_influence(), kb_plot_trace(), loo.kb_fit(), pp_check.kb_fit()

Examples

kb_sensitivity(fit_weight_sim_nereo)
#> # A tibble: 7 × 6
#>   term         prior_cjs likelihood_cjs weak_prior strong_data informative_prior
#>   <chr>            <dbl>          <dbl> <lgl>      <lgl>       <lgl>            
#> 1 intercept      0.0105          0.0352 TRUE       FALSE       FALSE            
#> 2 diameter_po…   0.0223          0.0944 TRUE       TRUE        FALSE            
#> 3 weight_floor   0.0164          0.143  TRUE       TRUE        FALSE            
#> 4 sd_site        0.0365          0.0665 TRUE       TRUE        FALSE            
#> 5 sd_year        0.0300          0.0649 TRUE       TRUE        FALSE            
#> 6 sd_site_year   0.00918         0.151  TRUE       TRUE        FALSE            
#> 7 sd_residual    0.00181         0.224  TRUE       TRUE        FALSE
